AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

WARRANTS
Recommendation:  Review and Approve Warrant Register of December 12, 2023.
Warrants
2.
RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE MONTHS ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2023, AND OCTOBER 31, 2023
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file financial statements for the months ending September 30, 2023, and October 31,2023.
Staff Report
3.
APPROVE AMENDMENT NO. 7 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR BUILDING AND SAFETY, ENGINEERING, AND PUBLIC WORKS SERVICES WITH HR GREEN PACIFIC, INC. (HR GREEN) MODIFYING THE TERMS FOR INVOICING AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE THE AMENDMENT
Recommendation: That the City Council approve Amendment No. 7 to the Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for Building and Safety, Engineering, and Public Works Services with HR Green Pacific, Inc. (HR Green) modifying the terms for invoicing and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment.
Staff Report
4.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R23-51 AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER OR DESIGNEE TO CAST VOTES FOR ALL FUTURE PALOS VERDES HOMES ASSOCIATION BOARD OF DIRECTORS ELECTION BY RETURNING THOSE BALLOTS STAMPED WITH THE CITY SEAL AND INDICATING PRESENT ON THE BALLOT WITHOUT VOTING FOR ANY PATICULAR CANDIDATE
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt resolution No. 23-51.
Staff Report
5.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R23-51 APPROPRIATING UNENCUMBERED GENERAL FUNDS IN THE AMOUNT OF $78,500 FOR RECRUITMENT OF CHIEF OF POLICE, FINANCE DIRECTOR, AND CITY CLERK AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXCUTE ALL CONTRACT DOCUMENTS WITH BOB MURRAY & ASSOCIATES
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt resolution No. 23-51, authorizing unencumbered general funds in the amount of $78,500 and authorizing the City Manager to execute all contract documents with Bob Murray & Associates for executive recruitment of the Chief of Police, Finance Director, and City Clerk.
Staff Report
6.
SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION OF THE LUNADA BAY HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION TO HOLD ITS “SANTA IN THE PARK” EVENT AT LUNADA BAY PARK ON WEDNESDAY DECEMBER 13, 2023
Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Special Event Application submitted by The Lunada Bay Homeowners’ Association for the Santa in the Park event held at Lunada Bay Park and the adjacent street of Via Anacapa on Wednesday, December 13, 2023 from 4:00pm to 7:00pm.
6_Staff Report
7.
CONSIDER A RESOLUTION APPROPRIATING UNENCUMBERED GENERAL FUND BALANCE (FUND 01) IN THE AMOUNT OF $35,000 AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE AGREEMENT WITH NV5 FOR SAMPLING AND TESTING SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $35,000 FOR A TOTAL CONTRACT AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $61,000
Recommendation: That the City Council: (1) Adopt a Resolution appropriating unencumbered General Fund Balance (Fund 01) in the amount of $35,000; and (2) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 2 to the Agreement with NV5 for sampling and testing services in an amount not to exceed $35,000 for a total contract amount not to exceed $61,000.
